purpose: Appendix-only normalized synthetic merchant-universe stress test extending the reference independent-unavailability experiment without re-estimating or modifying any reference result.

write_gates.result_policy: retain_all_completed, adverse, mixed, null, failed, and scope-limiting outcomes
write_gates.selection_policy: no outcome-based filtering, seed removal, metric substitution, or silent reruns

relationship_to_main.reference_result: The reported 32.7 percentage-point comparison remains the frozen AP2-1, p_unavail=0.5, independent-unavailability result.
relationship_to_main.forbidden_interpretation: Do not present E6 as production market evidence, a replacement estimate, or evidence that MinMandate dominates every AP2-k condition.
relationship_to_main.adverse_result_action: Record independently and stop before supplement integration pending explicit user decision.

design.statistical_unit: unique base task; repeated seeds and planners remain within the task cluster
design.normalized_universe_rule: For each frozen task and service class, place its unique frozen source-preferred merchant first, retain the other frozen admitted merchants in approval order, and append deterministic schema-compatible synthetic IDs until the requested exact size is reached.
design.synthetic_merchant_scope: Offline interchangeable merchant identifiers only; no live service, account, payment rail, or claim about real merchant quality.
design.availability_rule: Reuse the frozen u value for every original task-seed-merchant key. Derive only new synthetic-merchant u values with the frozen SHA-256 salt rule. Threshold the same u at every p so masks remain nested and shared across planners and conditions.
design.execution_path: Actual pinned AP2 v0.2 AP2QueryFreeController replay and actual same-source MinMandate policy/Rust replay imported from experiments/scripts/run_coverage_replay.py; pure coverage-only simulation is forbidden.

budget_semantics: Allowed-merchant enumeration does not multiply the frozen approved spend cap in the reference AP2 baseline. Verify the non-merchant draft hash is invariant; do not fabricate k-times budget inflation.
